::: {#sol-broken-promise}

Only in the second row:
the child cleaned the room and got no dessert.

When the room was not cleaned,
the promise says nothing about dessert,
so the parent kept it whether or not dessert came.

Writing $P$ for "you clean your room"
and $Q$ for "you get dessert",
the promise "if $P$, then $Q$" is false only when $P$ is true and $Q$ is false.

:::
